note: Fictional sample messages. humanLabel is the hand label for comparison; the app classifies live with the TS rules.

messages.subject: PO-778812 – Dengue NS1 Ag ELISA 96T
messages.body:
Dear Lives team,

Please find attached PO-778812 for 40 boxes of Dengue NS1 Ag ELISA 96T (I-A-000812), delivery to our Level 2 lab by 6 Nov.

Regards,
Purchasing Dept

messages.subject: Do you carry dengue NS1 rapid kits?
messages.body: Hi, do you carry dengue NS1 kits? What is the price and lead time for Singapore? We are comparing suppliers for the season.

messages.subject: When will PO-55120 be delivered?
messages.body: Hello, when will PO-55120 be delivered? Our ward is running low. Can you share the tracking number?

messages.subject: Quote Q-2207 accepted – Dengue IgG/IgM Combo 30T
messages.body: We accept quotation Q-2207 and intend to order 300 kits of Dengue IgG/IgM Combo 30T. Please confirm and we will raise the PO once the item is in your system.

messages.subject: New item code needed: Dengue NS1 Ag Rapid Test 25T
messages.body: Hi MDM, please set up a new item code for Dengue NS1 Ag Rapid Test 25T (Product A, IVD reagent). Supplier details and HSA licence to follow.

messages.subject: Purchase order PO#450921
messages.body: Please process PO#450921: 12 x Haematology Diluent 20L and 6 x Haematology Lyse 5L. Ship to Bangkok main warehouse.

messages.subject: Pipette tips availability?
messages.body: Could you tell us whether you have 200µL filtered pipette tips in stock in Ho Chi Minh City, and the price per pack?

messages.subject: Invoice INV-30418 query
messages.body: Dear sir, invoice INV-30418 for our last order shows the wrong unit price. Please send a corrected invoice.

messages.subject: Intend to order 120 kits – combo dengue
messages.body: Following your quote Q-2213, we intend to order 120 kits of the Dengue IgG/IgM Combo 30T. Waiting for your item code to raise PO.

messages.subject: Please set up new customer: Klang Lembah Diagnostik
messages.body: Hi team, new customer setup needed for Klang Lembah Diagnostik (SSM 202101012345). They want to start ordering CRP reagents next month.

messages.subject: PO 6620145 – urinalysis strips
messages.body: Kindly supply as per PO 6620145: 50 boxes Urinalysis Strip 10-Parameter 100s. Payment by bank transfer as usual.

messages.subject: Information on PCR kits
messages.body: Good day. Does Lives Group supply dengue PCR kits in Myanmar? Please share the catalogue and registration status.

messages.subject: Delivery status – order SO-88213
messages.body: Hi, could you update us on the delivery status of our order SO-88213? It was due last Friday.

messages.subject: Quotation accepted – nitrile gloves
messages.body: Quotation Q-2240 is accepted. We plan to purchase 800 boxes Nitrile Gloves M 100/bx (I-B-000224). Please prepare contract.

messages.subject: Vendor setup – new reagent supplier
messages.body: Please create a new vendor record for our new Thai reagent supplier; registration documents attached for QA review.

messages.subject: PO-2026-10-0441
messages.body: Attached PO-2026-10-0441 for 25 units of hs-Troponin I Cartridge 25T. Please deliver to the main lab.

messages.subject: Price for HbA1c point-of-care analyser?
messages.body: Hello, what would an HbA1c point-of-care analyser cost, and do you offer reagent rental?

messages.subject: PO-778190 partial delivery
messages.body: We received only half of PO-778190. When will the remaining boxes arrive? Please advise.

messages.subject: Ready to order – CO2 incubator
messages.body: We have approval and intend to order 2 units of CO2 Incubator 170L as per your quote Q-2251. Please send final terms.

messages.subject: Extend customer to QTG
messages.body: Please extend customer Song Sen General Hospital to QTG so we can quote consumables. Existing SPD record.

messages.subject: PO 300987 – reagents
messages.body: Please accept PO 300987 for 60 packs CRP Latex Reagent 4x50mL and 30 packs Creatinine Enzymatic 4x60mL.

messages.company: Bang Na Bio Research Co., Ltd.
messages.subject: Do you distribute agarose?
messages.body: Hi, do you distribute Agarose LE in Thailand? What pack sizes are available?

messages.subject: Credit note for returned goods
messages.body: Following our return last week on PO-55311, please issue the credit note so we can close the account.

messages.subject: New cost centre for new BU
messages.body: Hi MDM, please create a new cost centre for the new BU starting 1 Dec; budget owner is me.

messages.subject: Confirm order intent – PCR plates
messages.body: We accept the quote and intend to order 150 packs PCR Plate 96-Well Skirted 25/pk. Please confirm availability before we issue the PO.
